terms.gloss: the water of a young coconut
terms.comment: Our description: aqua, water, and nux Indica, the coconut (Morgan–Owens). No reference work we searched (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini) has a word for the clear water of a young coconut; the milk pressed from its flesh is another thing (see “coconut milk”).

phrases.latin: Vīn' ex ipsā nuce bibere? Sīphōnem tibi indam.
phrases.english: Do you want to drink straight from the coconut? I’ll put a straw in for you.

phrases.latin: Aqua nucis Indicae frīgida et dulcis est.
phrases.english: Coconut water is cool and sweet.

phrases.latin: Ubi ēbiberis, nucem aperiam, et pulpam cochleāre exedēmus.
phrases.english: When you’ve drunk it all, I’ll open the coconut and we’ll scoop out the flesh with a spoon.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. coconut.
